_note: Name-facts for Equatorial Guinea (FT-72, docs/PLAN_V0.12.md). See italy.json for the rules.
Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region
of the same id, written later, never shows a town's sentences.

en: Its bay is a flooded volcanic crater on the island of Bioko.
A new capital, Ciudad de la Paz, is being built on the mainland.
it: Si chiamò Santa Isabel fino al 1973.
La sua baia è un cratere vulcanico sommerso sull’isola di Bioko.
Una nuova capitale, Ciudad de la Paz, è in costruzione sul continente.
de: Ihre Bucht ist ein überfluteter Vulkankrater auf der Insel Bioko.
Eine neue Hauptstadt, Ciudad de la Paz, wird auf dem Festland gebaut.
